design_checks: setup help opens without scene changes and exposes official links and copyable install command
actual native dialog contains both mirror controls; screenshot saved
behavior_checks: dry run validates actual edited data without changing scene or source masks
all ARM IDs and custom child mirror exactly across KJI axis 2
both existing working side nodes remain byte-for-byte equal as arrays
right-to-left reflection restores every edited source voxel and parcel ID
saved native .seg.nrrd reloads with every segment and voxel unchanged
mirror provenance survives .seg.nrrd reload as a scope-segment tag
arbitrary source annotation metadata survives mirroring and native save/reload
existing mirror output is refused without overwrite
native Validate and Mirror button signals create a new candidate and enable saving
overlap with another seed is rejected before creating any candidate
registered source image and atlas hashes remain unchanged

validation.ci: Workflow provided; actual run status is available in GitHub Actions for each commit, separate from local validation.

limitations: Technical validation does not establish anatomical boundaries, biological symmetry or human acceptance.
Native test changes are synthetic and in-memory; no human annotation distributed.
Full bilateral integer-label NIfTI export/merge is not implemented.
Project code license not selected; external NMT/ARM terms and citations remain separate.
